mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, category_id, title, content, fav, status, audit_status, origin, attachment_path, created_time, update_time, deleted FROM article WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE article SET user_id = #{userId}, category_id = #{categoryId}, title = #{title}, content = #{content}, fav = #{fav}, status = #{status}, audit_status = #{auditStatus}, attachment_path = #{attachmentPath}, update_time = #{updateTime}, deleted = #{deleted} WHERE id = #{id}
